newsitem.title: USA: Secondary market for inner city loans eyed - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Secondary market for inner city loans eyed - Rubin.

text.p: U.S. Treasury and Commerce Department officials are looking at ways to pool inner city business loans and sell them in the secondary market, U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Friday.

He told a Congressional Black Caucus Foundation legislative conference that officials hope the first loan sales could be made within the next six monthsm, but a number of difficulties remain to be worked out.
The idea "involves a lot of challenges which we haven't fully resolved, but if we can it will be a very, very powerful program," Rubin said.
He said selling inner city loans to the secondary market will put more capital into the hands of inner city lenders.
